REQUEST CASE FILE — one request, one thread, one honest clock
Design chosen unanimously by a 3-judge panel (parent advocate · staff engineer · legal-aid lens) over evidence-first and minimal-change rivals, with their best ideas grafted in.

Spine: communications.request_id (migration 047) — stamped at send, inherited by Gmail replies via trigger, ambiguity-guarded (a thread serving two requests never auto-attaches). Pure lib/requestCase.ts derives thread order (occurred_at, never the falsely-stamped sent_at), provenance tiers (Gmail-dated / contemporaneous / from memory), and the next lever on the existing 4-rung ladder. Silence climbs the ladder; conversation never does (your tone rule, structural).

THE DOSSIER
Exact-linked items only in the core table; thread-closure-only items live in a default-excluded 'Related correspondence' section. Attestations state what the packet can and cannot prove — no immutability overclaim (tests enforce this). SHA-256 fingerprint in the footer. Web = real printable PDF in two taps; native = labeled text share until expo-print is approved.

OPEN QUESTIONS (plan doc has detail)
1 · Premium-gate the export? My rec: FREE — it's the trust moment of the product.
2 · Approve expo-print for native one-tap PDF? My rec: yes, phase 3.
3 · Manual detach control for off-topic replies — v1.1?
4 · Who native-speaker-reviews the ES/VI dossier copy?
5 · Thin-thread copy for phone-first families — 'your record so far', never broken-looking.

Build: 3 phases, ~6-7 days. Phase 1 data spine + pure logic · Phase 2 case screen + badge-the-job · Phase 3 dossier.
